item.title: 1909 pUjA proposal
item.description:
विस्तारः - शठकोप-तातार्यः

द्राविडवेदपारायणस्य कालो देशश्च निर्णीतः।तमुल्लङ्घ्य यथेच्छं करिष्यन्ति।अधिकारिणाम् सकाशे वयं न्यूनकैङ्कर्यशालिनः।
वडकला ताताचार्या अस्माकमुपरोधं कुर्वन्तीति दोषान् वदेयुः।
आगामिनि वैशाखोत्सवे सर्वानस्मान् प्रतार्य कोलाहलं करिष्यन्तीति।

During Puja, in the whole of the first and second asanas, the Upanishads should be recited.

item.title: 1911 pba jailed post apology defamation
item.description:
Context

Ozhapakkam Ramanujachariar famously converted from TK to VK.

Summary of Proceedings

Events

  1. The accused, a Thengalai Brahmin aged 20, was charged with defaming the complainant, a Vadagalai Brahmin, by publishing a pamphlet alleging:
  • The complainant was the son of a prostitute.
  • His mother openly lived with several men.
  • He lived on his wife’s prostitution.

  1. In Case No. 102/1910, the complainant had earlier charged the accused with defamation in a Sanskrit work. That case was dismissed but later retried by order of the High Court. The accused apologized, and the complainant accepted it on 2 September 1911.

item.title: 1950 PBA apology
item.description:
D No. 325|1360
From
Sri. K. Madhava Row,
Executive Trustee.
Sri Devarajaswami Devasthanam, Kancheepuram. 13–11–50.

To
The Secretary,
The Hindu Religious Endowments Board,
Madras.

Sir,

Sub:- High handed action shown by the thengalai people on 10–11–50- disciplinery action proposed to take against four persons report submitted to the Board (Vide D.No.316/1360 dated 11-11-50)

Since the submission of the report to Board dated 11–11–50, Sri P.B. Annangarachariar the leader of the Thennacharya darsana saba ( thengalai community) and the persons who assaulted me on 10–11–50 came to me and tendered their unconditional appology and also repented their action in the presence of Sri T. Krishnamachariar, retired Inspector of police and some respectable gentlemen and also accepted their misdeeds.

item.title: 2012 scheme
item.description:
विस्तारः (द्रष्टुं नोद्यम्)

Under stay by 2019 judgement.

  1. Thathachariar Trustee

  2. One Smartha or Madhwa Brahmin Trustee

  3. One Thenkalai Brahmin Trustee

  4. One Non-Brahmin Sri Vaishnavite Trustee

  5. One Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribes Trustee. Among the Serial number 1 to 4 one must be a woman Trustee.

  6. In the impugned scheme equal representation has been given to Thathachariar family, Smartha or Madhwa brahmins, Thenkalai brahmin, non-brahmin vaishnavite, Schedule Caste and Schedule Tribe and a Woman. So, it is a balanced one.

item.title: parakAla-yati 1370
item.description:
EPIGRAPHIA INDICA, Vol. XXV.

No. 34.—CONJEEVERAM INSCRIPTION OF BRAHMA-TANTRA-SVATANTRA-JIYAR: SAKA 1282.

By A. S. RAMANATHA AYYAR, B.A., MADRAS.

Intro

Kāñchīpuram in the Chingleput District was an important place of pilgrimage from very early times. Portions of this town and its environs were in the olden days known according to their religious associations, as the Buddha-Kāñchī, Jina-Kāñchī, Śiva-Kāñchī and Vishṇu-Kāñchī.1 The inscription2 published below is engraved on the north wall of the second prākāra of the Varadarāja temple at Little Conjeeveram, otherwise called Vishṇu-Kāñchī, which is very sacred to the Vaishṇavas of the south.
